Billion kWh Purchase Commitment
Percentage of U.S. Electricity Use

Since 2013, our annual purchase of Renewable Energy Certificates (RECs) have equaled 100%  
of our U.S. electricity use. Our RECs include a portfolio of wind, solar, small hydroelectric, 
geothermal, and biomass sources.
